exercises.sentence: Tras meses de inflación alta, el banco central acabó ____ subir las tasas de interés.
exercises.english: After months of high inflation, the central bank ended up raising interest rates.

exercises.sentence: En pocos años, el país pasó ____ ser el principal exportador de la región.
exercises.english: Within a few years, the country went on to become the region's main exporter.
exercises.hint: preposition with pasar for 'went on to'

exercises.sentence: El aumento de los aranceles terminó por encarecer la importación de productos industriales.
options: The cut in tariffs ended up making the import of industrial products more expensive.
The rise in tariffs ended up making the export of industrial products more expensive.
The rise in tariffs ended up making the import of industrial products more expensive.

exercises.question: Which sentence uses *pasar a* + infinitive correctly to mark a structural shift?
options: La demanda externa pasó de impulsar la producción industrial del país.
La demanda externa pasó a impulsar la producción industrial del país.
La demanda externa pasó impulsar la producción industrial del país.

exercises.question: Why did basic goods become more expensive according to the opening paragraph of the column?
options: Because the central bank lowered interest rates sharply during a period of falling savings.
Because domestic industries stopped selling at home and moved their production abroad.
Because higher production costs coincided with firm domestic demand that supply could not always meet.

exercises.question: What does the column say happens to state tax revenue during an economic slowdown?
options: It rises sharply because higher interest rates increase the profits of the banks.
It tends to fall because lower activity reduces tax revenue just when more support is demanded.
It stays at the same level because export companies cover the fiscal deficit.

exercises.question: What does the column say the recovery will require regardless of the central bank's timetable?
options: Patience, orderly liquidity and predictable rules to rebuild confidence.
Immediate tariff increases and a freeze on household loans.
A rapid cut in interest rates even if inflation picks up again.

prompt.speaker: Meg
prompt.text: ¿Qué pasó al final con la subida de las tasas de interés que explicaba la columna?

options: Acabó por frenar el consumo y redujo la inversión privada.
Acabó de frenar el consumo y redujo la inversión privada.
Acabó a frenar el consumo y redujo la inversión privada.

template.prompt: Translate using «pasaron a ocupar», «las exportaciones» and «el primer lugar»: "Exports moved into first place."
template.answer: Las exportaciones pasaron a ocupar el primer lugar.

template.prompt: Translate using «pasó a impulsar» and «la producción»: "External demand went on to boost production."
template.answer: La demanda externa pasó a impulsar la producción.

exercises.question: Which sentence means 'The committee ended up approving the tariff' rather than 'just approved'?
options: El comité acabó de aprobar el arancel tras una larga discusión.
El comité acabó por aprobar el arancel tras una larga discusión.
El comité dejó de aprobar el arancel tras una larga discusión.
